华南地区每个产品的销售总额
cases.sql:
SELECT T3.product_name, SUM(T1.amount) AS 销售总额
FROM fact_sales AS T1
JOIN dim_region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.region_id
JOIN dim_product AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id
WHERE T2.region_name = '华南'
GROUP BY T3.product_id, T3.product_name;

JOIN dim_product ON fact_sales.product_id = dim_product.product_id
GROUP BY dim_region.region_name, dim_product.category;

cases.question: 华中地区销售额最高的五个产品及其销售额

SELECT T3.product_name, SUM(T1.amount) AS sales_amount

cases.question: 按产品统计最高单笔销售金额
cases.sql: SELECT T2.product_name, MAX(T1.amount) AS 最高单笔销售金额 FROM fact_sales AS T1 JOIN dim_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_id, T2.product_name

cases.question: 按区域统计最低单笔销售金额
cases.sql:
SELECT T2.region_name, MIN(T1.amount) AS 最低单笔销售金额
FROM fact_sales AS T1
JOIN dim_region AS T2 ON T1.region_id = T2.region_id
GROUP BY T2.region_name;

cases.question: 每个城市各有几家门店
cases.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(store_id) AS 门店数量 FROM dim_store GROUP BY city;

cases.question: 按品类汇总销售总金额
cases.sql:
SELECT T2.category, SUM(T1.amount) AS 销售总金额
FROM fact_sales AS T1
JOIN dim_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id
GROUP BY T2.category;

cases.question: 最近 30 天的销售总金额
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售总金额 FROM fact_sales WHERE sale_date >= DATE('now', '-30 days') AND sale_date <= DATE('now');

cases.question: 今年的销售订单总数
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(sale_id) AS 订单总数 FROM fact_sales WHERE strftime('%Y', sale_date) = strftime('%Y', 'now')

cases.question: 上个月的销售总金额
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售总金额
FROM fact_sales
WHERE sale_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND sale_date < date('now', 'start of month');

cases.question: 上个月的退款总金额
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS 退款总金额 FROM fact_refund WHERE refund_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND refund_date < date('now', 'start of month');

cases.question: 2026 年 9 月的销售总金额
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售总金额 FROM fact_sales WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date < '2026-10-01';
